title: Simulated cross-region restore scheduler with automated health validators
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build an automated scheduler that performs simulated cross-region restores for Private (VPC) deployments and validates application health using a battery of non-destructive checks. This ticket covers Terraform hooks, orchestration, and health validators that will be reused in periodic failover drills and upgrade rehearsals.

Scope:
- Orchestrate scheduled simulated restores from REGION-A -> REGION-B in customer-like private VPC stacks using existing Terraform modules (no destructive production data writes).
- Implement a pluggable health-validation framework (API probe, KV cache warm, latency SLO smoke, token-count sanity checks, and example inference test prompts).
- Add IaC lifecycle hooks to trigger stateful snapshots, restore workflows, and optional reconciliation after the simulation completes.

Out of scope: automated cross-account networking reconfiguration, actual DNS cutover for customer traffic, and manual runbook steps for legal/compliance approvals.

Success criteria:
- Scheduler triggers end-to-end simulation in 3 target environments (staging, preprod, canary) with isolated VPCs and no customer data exposure.
- Health validators return PASS/FAIL and a deterministic failure reason for any check; failures written to the Console observability dashboard and GitHub issue created automatically.
- Terraform modules include idempotent hooks and a toggle flag so customers can opt-in to the simulated restore feature when onboarding private deployments.
tasks: Design scheduler CRD/Job semantics and configuration schema (frequency, targets, safe-mode toggles)
Extend terraform/private-modules to expose 'restore_simulation' lifecycle hook and variables
Implement health-validation library (http probe, kv-warm, inference-sanity, latency-smoke)
Wire orchestration to Console: emit events, trace IDs, and upload results to the DR-dashboard
Create Canary runbook and add to automation to run after terraform apply
Add automated GitHub issue creation for failed runs with logs and failing validator signatures
Integration tests: simulate on staging with mocked S3/KV and assert no external DNS changes
test_plan: Unit tests for validator library (edge cases, timeouts)
End-to-end integration test in isolated preprod VPC: simulate restore and assert validators PASS
Chaos test: inject delayed KV restore and assert failure reason and retry behavior logged
Smoke test for terraform hooks to ensure idempotent re-run after failure
Manual review: security team runs checklist on simulation artifacts before enabling for enterprise customers
rollout_plan: Deploy to staging during maintenance window and run first scheduled simulation with on-call oversight
Run 3 consecutive successful simulations in preprod, then enable for select customers in canary
Open the new DR-dashboard to engineering and SRE for 2 weeks for feedback before wider rollout
Document runbook and add to DR tabletop exercise checklist
